design.teacher_topk_cutoff_ties: uses listed top-k; ties inherit legal-move iteration order
design.primary_endpoint: mean held-out probability mass on the teacher's listed top-k moves at final checkpoint
design.source_game_sampling: one random nonterminal position per random-play game

summary.primary_endpoint: mean held-out probability mass on the teacher's listed top-k moves at final checkpoint
summary.power_planning_method: t critical value plus normal 80% power quantile; approximate, not exact noncentral-t
summary.interval_scope: conditional on this fixed training corpus and held-out set; estimates initialization-seed variability only
summary.power_planning_scope: conditional on the fixed corpora; excludes training-corpus and held-out-position sampling uncertainty; refine with an exact noncentral-t method before confirmation
summary.interpretation: exploratory variance pilot only; no confirmatory claim
